_comment: Map of friendly recipient name -> 1-based slot index in the AirDrop picker (left-to-right). The picker order is stable across days for the same nearby devices; rebuild this file if devices move in/out of range or when devices first appear.
_how_to_populate: Run the picker once (~/Library/Hermes/airdrop <any-file>) so the recipient row is visible. Read the names left-to-right off the screen. Add each as "<name>": <slot>. Do NOT trust LLM vision alone — Apple hides names in the accessibility tree, and OCR/vision misreads small icon labels (this skill once sent a file to the wrong device because vision misread slot 2 as 'btekin' when it was actually a different device).
